Subject:    Submittal of Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Limited Work Authorization Application

References: [1] 300-USNRC 123 "Submittal of Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Limited Work
            Authorization Application (ADAMS Accession No. ML26009A012)
            [2] U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. (2026, February 13). Acceptance
            review results for a limited work authorization application for SMR-300 Pioneer
            Units 1 and 2 (ADAMS Accession No. ML26041A223).

By letter dated December 31, 2025 (ML26009A012), SMR, LLC, a Holtec International
company, submitted the first part of a phased construction permit application to the U.S.
Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) for the proposed dual-unit SMR-300 facility at the
Palisades Energy Center (PEC) in Covert, Michigan. The application included a request
for a limited work authorization (LWA) pursuant to Title 10 of the Code of Federal
Regulations (10 CFR) 50.10, "License required; limited work authorization." The proposed
units are designated as Pioneer Unit 1 and Pioneer Unit 2.

Pursuant to 10 CFR 50.10 and 2.101 (a)(9), SMR, LLC, on behalf of Palisades SMR, LLC,
hereby submits Revision 1 to Enclosures I through VI of the LWA application for the
proposed dual-unit SMR-300 facility. The revised enclosures supersede the
corresponding portions of Enclosures I through VI submitted with the original LWA
application.

The revised enclosures are submitted in support of the Revision 1 LWA application and
 reflect updates to the application and supporting information. Enclosures I and II have
 been revised to provide updated general information regarding the planned construction
 activities and the information required by 10 CFR 2.101 (a)(9). The financial information
 in that enclosure is based on the company's information at the time of the initial submittal.
 Enclosure I contains proprietary information, and Enclosure II contains the corresponding
 non-proprietary, redacted version. Enclosures Ill and IV have been revised to provide an
 updated Preliminary Safety Analysis Report for Pioneer Units 1 and 2, including
,information relating to the structures, systems, and components relevant to the proposed
 LWA activities and construction hazards associated with the operating Palisades Nuclear
 Plant. Enclosure Ill contains proprietary information, and Enclosure IV contains the

corresponding non-proprietary, redacted information. Enclosures V and VI have been
revised to provide updated exemption requests associated with the proposed LWA
activities. Enclosure V contains proprietary information, and Enclosure VI contains the
corresponding non-proprietary, redacted information. Enclosure VII provides the affidavit
supporting SMR's request to withhold the proprietary information from public disclosure
pursuant to 10 CFR 2.390.

The revised application information has been prepared in accordance with the applicable
requirements of 10 CFR Part 50 and is consistent, where applicable, with the format and
content guidance provided in Regulatory Guide 1.206, "Applications for Nuclear Power
Plants."

Portions of the LWA application and supporting information previously submitted to the
NRC that are not revised by this submittal remain unchanged and are, not resubmitted.
Except for the revisions provided in Enclosures I through VI and the proprietary-
information affidavit provided in Enclosure VII, the LWA application remains unchanged.

SMR respectfully requests that the NRC docket and review Enclosures I through VI as
supplements to the previously submitted LWA application. Enclosure VII is provided in
support of SMR's request to withhold proprietary information from public disclosure
pursuant to 10 CFR 2.390. The requests for approval and review schedules provided in
the original submittal remain applicable unless superseded by information provided in the
revised enclosures.

If you have any questions or require any additional information, please contact Kimberly
Manzione,     Executive    Director    Licensing      and    Regulatory     Affairs,  at
K.Manzione@holtec.com or 856-797-0900 ext. 3951 .

I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct. Executed on 29
September 2026.
